title: Richer Output for Richer Countries: Uncovering Geographical Disparities in Generated Stories and Travel Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting large language models to generate travel recommendations and geo-anchored stories for diverse global locations, and evaluating the outputs for uniqueness (using a modified TF-IDF metric and Type-Token Ratio), informativeness (counting geographic entities extracted via SpaCy NER), and emotional tone (classifying joy, hardship, and sadness using GPT-4 as an annotator).

Calculating Pearson correlation coefficients between the evaluated text metrics (uniqueness, informativeness, and emotional tone) of the location-specific outputs and the GDP per capita of each respective country to quantify disparities between wealthy and poor nations.
